name: Longsword
description: A versatile martial weapon. 1d8 slashing (1d10 two-handed).

name: Chain Mail
description: Heavy armor. AC 16. Str 13 required. Disadvantage on Stealth.

name: Healing Potion
description: Regain 2d4+2 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Rope, Hempen (50 ft)
description: 50 feet of hempen rope. 2 hit points, can be burst with DC 17 Strength check.

name: Torch
description: Bright light 20 ft, dim light 20 ft beyond. Burns for 1 hour.

name: Rations (1 day)
description: Dry food suitable for travel. Includes jerky, dried fruit, and hardtack.

name: Bedroll
description: A portable sleeping roll for camping.

name: Tinderbox
description: Flint, fire steel, and tinder. Light a torch or campfire as an action.

name: Iron Ingot
description: A bar of refined iron suitable for smithing.

name: Leather Scraps
description: Pieces of cured leather for crafting armor or accessories.

name: Alchemist's Supplies
description: Tools for creating potions and alchemical substances. Proficiency required.

name: Gemstone (Ruby)
description: A fine red ruby. Valued at approximately 500 gp.
